metadata.title: ThreatCore Framework User Stories
metadata.description: Attacker user stories for MITRE ATT&CK and ATLAS techniques, and defender user stories for D3FEND countermeasures. Curated entries draw on documented intrusions, vendor IR reports, and community case studies.
metadata.story_format: As a [persona], I want to [action] so that [outcome].

entries.name: Data Obfuscation
entries.user_story: As a threat actor during command and control, I want to obfuscate command and control traffic to make it more difficult to detect so that I maintain reliable, encrypted communication with compromised hosts.
entries.real_world_example: LockBit, BlackCat, and ALPHV affiliates encrypt domain-wide; double extortion combines encryption with data theft.

entries.user_story: As a threat actor during command and control, I want to use Junk Data to add junk data to protocols used for command and control to make detection more difficult so that I maintain reliable, encrypted communication with compromised hosts.
entries.real_world_example: Delayed detection in major breaches often traces to insufficient or tampered logging.

entries.name: OS Credential Dumping
entries.user_story: As a threat actor during credential access, I want to attempt to dump credentials to obtain account login and credential material, normally in the form of a hash or a clear text password so that I obtain secrets usable for lateral movement and privilege escalation.
entries.real_world_example: LSASS dumping is observed in nearly every serious Windows intrusion investigation.
